title: Soft Glam vs Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Is Right for You?
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam can feel overwhelming, but understanding each style makes the decision beautifully simple.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, delicate lashes, and neutral tones that photograph effortlessly in natural Fort Lauderdale light. Full glam, with its sculpted contour, bold lashes, and dramatic liner, commands attention and thrives under ballroom chandeliers. Your venue, dress silhouette, and personal style are the best guides to choosing the look that feels authentically and breathtakingly you.
